author: Mark Atwood
text:
Same workspace-canonical propagation concern as JMAP-510h.44 and JMAP-510h.40. The bead's own description says 'Apply the fix to mail-server first per the canonical-template rule, then propagate.'

Filed a consolidated workspace propagation epic JMAP-xbeb that bundles all three beads' workspace-sweep concerns into one coordinated effort:

- JMAP-xbeb: 'Workspace propagation epic: extension-server trait + handler + re-export contract sweep'

When JMAP-xbeb decomposes into per-crate children, this bead's filenode-server re-export audit becomes one of those children. Until then, JMAP-510h.39 stays human-labeled because the decision to commit to the 22-child sweep needs human judgment.

Recommendation: defer JMAP-510h.39 until JMAP-xbeb decomposes. The do-beads --epic JMAP-510h session has nothing more to do on this bead.
